epics.title: Project Progress and Deliverable Readiness Tracking
epics.jtbd: When project stakeholders review project status, I want the deliverable readiness metric to update accurately, so that I have a true view of progress and do not receive false stagnation warnings.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce deliverable readiness stagnation duration from >3 cycles to 0
requirements: R1: Fix the deliverable readiness calculation logic so that the ratio updates properly instead of being stuck at 5/19.

slices.title: Patch deliverable readiness calculation logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the calculation fix for this epic, I want to patch the existing code directly, so that the deliverable readiness accurately moves past the 5/19 stagnation point.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the deliverable readiness is currently recorded as stuck at 5/19 (~26%)
When a subsequent progress evaluation cycle occurs
Then the deliverable readiness calculation logic processes the current state correctly
And the readiness ratio updates to a value reflecting actual progress rather than stalling
slices.sixSigmaMetric: eliminate the 26 percent deliverable readiness calculation error rate
